text:
Olivia: Quick reminder — pre-holiday week potluck + ‘Festive Desk Lighting’ photo contest next Thursday (Dec 21). Who's bringing snacks and who wants to enter the desk glow-off? :tada: :desktop_computer: :sparkles:
Ben: I can bring savory stuff — mini quiches and a veggie tray. Count me in for the snack table. :yum:
Maria: Ooh mini quiches = chef ben energy. I'll bring cookies (and probably too many). Also entering the desk contest — I have fairy lights. :cookie: :stars:
Samir: I’ll sign up for drinks. Hot cocoa station? Also can help with cups/napkins. :coffee:
Ava: I’ll enter the desk contest if it counts that my plant will wear a tiny scarf. :evergreen_tree: :scarf:
Kevin: FYI we should avoid nuts for shared snacks (allergy heads up). I’ll bring paper plates + forks. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Can someone drop a one-line sign-up? I'll do a quick poll for categories (Most Festive, Most Minimalist, Most Likely to Blink at 2am). :smile:
Olivia: Sign-up doc: https://tinyurl.com/rw-holiday-potluck — add dish and whether it needs reheating. Poll categories list in the doc. Also please mark dietary tags (V/GF/N for vegan/gluten-free/nuts).
Ben: Added quiches (GF option). Hot cocoa sounds great — Samir, do you want a slow cooker?
Samir: Yup I can bring a slow cooker and marshmallows. Also can bring a small label maker for allergen tags.
Kevin: Thanks Samir. Also can we set up a 1-min announcement during all-hands to avoid last-minute surprises? :speaker:
Olivia: Good idea — I'll put a 30s slot on Thurs all-hands agenda. CalendarBot: Event "RW Holiday Potluck + Festive Desk Lighting" scheduled for 2023-12-21 12:00-13:00 in HQ Kitchen.
Ava: Photo contest rules: 1) desk must be mostly work-safe 2) one photo per person 3) voting ends 6pm Thurs. Winner gets a mystery prize (I vote for a coffee shop gift card).
Maria: Mystery prize accepted. Also I may have a tiny inflatable reindeer. No regrets. :deer:
Priya: Poll in doc updated with categories. If anyone can't make it but wants to contribute snacks, mark "drop-off" and I'll coordinate pickup.
Ben: Will bring an extra tote for drop-offs. :+1:
Olivia: Thanks team — this will be fun. PS: Secret Santa wrap-up — please drop gifts at reception by Wed EOD if you haven't. :santa:
Samir: Noted. See you all (and your twinkly desks) next week! :tada:
Olivia: Reminder: photos should be taken at lunch window so everyone can vote. Thread closed for planning — ping me for logistics.
